commands.command:
set -eu
cd /tmp/bloomml-m02.EonI5d/source
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = f780b2d4a88c2cf72c7160295d8fdea274eb0341
backup="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/bloomml-m02-recovery.XXXXXX")"
git diff --binary HEAD > "$backup/tracked.patch"
git ls-files --others --exclude-standard > "$backup/untracked.txt"
tar -cf "$backup/untracked.tar" -T "$backup/untracked.txt"
git status --short > "$backup/status.txt"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$backup/base.txt"
(cd "$backup" && shasum -a 256 tracked.patch untracked.txt untracked.tar status.txt base.txt > SHA256SUMS && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS)
printf 'BACKUP_DIRECTORY|%s\n' "$backup"
git diff --check
printf '\nTRACKED_DIFF\n'
git diff HEAD -- lib/environment_control/src/climate src/climate/application src/climate/runtime/core/RealInputRuntimeCoordinator.h src/climate/runtime/core/RealInputRuntimeCoordinator.cpp
printf '\nNEW_CONTRACTS\n'
while IFS= read -r path; do printf '\n--- %s ---\n' "$path"; cat "$path"; done < "$backup/untracked.txt"
